text:
The Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes was initially established in Dresden in 1925 as a department of the Deutsche Studentenschaft, but it was dissolved in 1934 under National Socialism. It was newly formed as a registered association in Cologne in 1948.
The Studienstiftung provides a general scholarship for bachelor's and master's studies, offering both financial and academic support based on BAFöG eligibility. It accepts exceptionally talented students and doctoral candidates according to its principles of "excellence, initiative and responsibility." Admission occurs through several channels, including nomination by a school, by professors, by an examination board, as winners of national/federal competitions, via an Assessment Test (since February 2010), by alums, or through support for musicians and artists. The organization also offers a doctoral scholarship for highly qualified and prosocial PhD students.
